# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation delivery refresh**

## Highlights

The next SkiaSharp release will ship compiler XML documentation alongside its managed packages. API documentation is now maintained with the C# source, while package and binding-generation changes make the consumer-facing documentation more consistent.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m154 fixes integrated** — Incorporates the latest upstream Chrome m154 renderer bug fixes into the forthcoming release line. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))

## API Surface

- **API documentation ships with packages** — Managed packages now include compiler XML documentation generated from the C# API comments, improving editor help for package consumers. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080), [#5053](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5053))
- **Generated bindings organized by type** — Splits generated P/Invoke bindings into per-type files and generates HarfBuzz bindings from the dependency-pinned source for more consistent binding output. ([#5056](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5056), [#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **View documentation supports Markdown** — View remarks can now be authored as Markdown for clearer rendered API documentation. ([#5091](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5091))
